name: GenUI
description: PI-Desktop port of omdsh-dev/dsh-genui: the model describes an interface as a dsh-ui JSON spec and the plugin renders it as real interactive components — stat/table/chart/plot, cards, steps, timelines, forms, quizzes with local grading, and an action loop back to the model.
changelog:
0.1.0 — first PI-Desktop release. Port of omdsh-dev/dsh-genui (MIT): 44 dsh-ui component types rendered in the plugin's own panel, hand-written SVG charts and function plots with zero third-party render engines, the render_ui / validate_dsh_ui / genui_status tools, a dsh-ui fence in a reply captured at message_end and rewritten to a one-line pointer, and panel actions returned to the model as a [genui-action] message.
Not implemented in this port: mermaid / echart / scene3d / diagram render as a labelled placeholder that preserves the original JSON.

en.name: GenUI
en.description: Give the model's answers a face: it describes an interface as a dsh-ui JSON spec and the plugin renders it as real interactive components in its own panel — stat cards, sortable/filterable tables, SVG charts and function plots, cards, steps, timelines, forms, quizzes graded locally, and an action loop back to the model. PI-Desktop exposes no plugin-extensible chat renderer, so a dsh-ui fence in a reply is captured and replaced by a one-line pointer instead of rendering inline.
en.safetyNotes: Requests four permissions: ui.panel, agent.tool.register, agent.prompt.inject and agent.extension. PI-Desktop exposes no plugin-extensible chat renderer, so a dsh-ui spec is rendered in this plugin's own panel window instead of inside the reply; the reply itself keeps only a one-line pointer. No fs, net, clipboard, shell, session or background-service permission is requested. Both halves (plugin process and agent sidecar) use Node.js fs to read and write ONLY this plugin's own data directory under the PI-Desktop user folder, one folder per plugin id, and only four fixed filenames there: config, state, action and panel-request. No workspace access, no network access, no caller-supplied path. Panel actions are delivered back to the model as a normal user message so the model can respond. Full capability and data-flow review: docs/capability-data-flow.md.

zh-CN.name: GenUI 生成式界面
zh-CN.description: 给回答装上界面：模型用 dsh-ui JSON 规格描述界面，插件在自己的面板里渲染成真实可交互组件——指标卡、可排序可过滤的表格、SVG 图表与函数曲线、卡片、步骤、时间线、表单、本地判卷测验，以及回传模型的动作回路。PI-Desktop 没有对插件开放的聊天渲染接口，因此回复里的 dsh-ui 围栏会被接管并替换为一行指引，而不是就地渲染。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 申请四项权限：ui.panel、agent.tool.register、agent.prompt.inject、agent.extension。PI-Desktop 没有对插件开放的聊天渲染接口，因此 dsh-ui 规格渲染在本插件自己的面板窗口里，而不是回复正文中；回复里只保留一行指引。不申请 fs、net、clipboard、shell、session、background.service。插件的两半（插件进程与 Agent 侧）都用 Node.js fs 读写，且仅读写本插件自己的数据目录，即 PI-Desktop 用户目录下按插件 id 分的一个文件夹，且只有四个固定文件名：config、state、action、panel-request。不访问工作区、不联网、不接受调用方传入的路径。面板上的动作会作为一条普通用户消息回传给模型。完整的能力与数据流审查见 docs/capability-data-flow.md。

agentTools.name: render_ui
agentTools.description: 把一份 dsh-ui JSON 规格渲染成真实可交互界面，显示在 GenUI 面板窗口中（PI-Desktop 没有聊天内围栏渲染，所以这是本插件渲染界面的主通道）。规格与上游 dsh-genui 的 ```dsh-ui 围栏格式完全一致：{"title":"...","items":[{"type":"stat",...}]}。组件词汇见 genui 技能。返回渲染结果（seq、组件数、被丢弃节点、是否含可交互动作）。

spec.description: dsh-ui 规格：可以是对象、根级数组、或双重编码的 JSON 字符串。例：{"title":"订单概览","items":[{"type":"stat","label":"营收","value":"¥128,430","delta":"+12.4%"}]}

title.description: 面板窗口标题（可选；缺省用规格的 title，再缺省用 “GenUI”）

replace.description: true（默认）= 替换面板当前内容；false = 追加到当前内容之后（用于分步补充）

agentTools.name: validate_dsh_ui
agentTools.description: 校验并归一化一份 dsh-ui 规格，但不在面板里渲染。返回归一化后的规格、被丢弃的节点与原因、别名归一化提示，以及最终组件数。在你不确定字段名或组件是否受支持时先调它。

spec.description: 要校验的 dsh-ui 规格（对象 / 根级数组 / 双重编码 JSON 字符串）

agentTools.name: genui_status
agentTools.description: 返回 GenUI 面板的当前状态：数据目录、当前 seq、标题、组件数、被丢弃节点数、是否含可交互动作、以及各开关（面板自动打开 / 围栏接管 / 动作回路）。
